base_typeface.selection_reason: Use a mature high-legibility Chinese skeleton so glyph correctness is inherited before a small number of brand-specific outline surgeries.

construction: created 茶 and 作 in Noto Sans SC Black and converted both to editable vector outlines
compressed 作 horizontally to 92 percent and vertically to 96 percent for optical pairing
applied one diagonal lower-right terminal cut to 作
added one tapered structural connector sweep derived from the accepted D one-piece identity
united the customized outlines and connector into one editable wordmark system

execution.route: Figma text -> flatten to vector outlines -> bounded subtractive terminal surgery -> one structural connector addition -> union

questions: Does this read immediately as 茶作?
Is the design-language change versus M03/R1 finally large enough to matter?
Does the mature base plus limited surgery feel more authored and commercially credible, or does it read as a font with an underline?

rule_admission.reason: M04 remains a single local research output pending actual-pixel human review and explicit user acceptance.
